title: Fabada Asturiana with Pan-Seared Veal
description: Authentic Spanish-inspired dish from the Asturias region, featuring tender veal and hearty fabada beans.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the veal chops and sear until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the veal to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked fabada beans, pimentón, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return the veal chops to the skillet and simmer until heated through.
Serve the veal chops with the fabada bean mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
